placements.title: Commanding erasure of specific knowledge
placements.frame: What specific knowledge does the speaker command the recipient to purge, and what hierarchical control over memory does the erasure directive perform?
placements.why: Both segments perform the same thematic act: a flat imperative commanding erasure of named knowledge — first the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts, then zeppelin routes. The relational dimension reads both as authority-ranking (the speaker allocates what the recipient may hold), and conviction reads both as decision-grade settled instructions. This is a thematic container — the subject of commanding knowledge erasure — that future envelopes could feed, not a one-time fact. No existing leaf holds this theme, so it is minted under the Calibration strata.
